3.name: Open Hand Technique
3.description: When Flurry of Blows hits, knock targets Prone (DEX save), push 15 ft (STR save), or strip their Reactions until the end of your next turn.

6.name: Wholeness of Body
6.description: Action regains 3 x Monk level HP once per Long Rest.

11.name: Tranquility
11.description: Gain the effect of a Sanctuary spell after every Long Rest (DC 8 + PB + WIS mod).

17.name: Quivering Palm
17.description: Spend 3 Ki on an unarmed strike to set lethal vibrations; later use an Action to drop target to 0 HP (CON save) or 10d10 Necrotic damage.

3.name: Shadow Arts
3.description: Learn Minor Illusion and spend 2 Ki to cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace, or Silence without material components.

6.name: Shadow Step
6.description: Bonus Action teleports 60 ft from dim light/darkness to dim light/darkness with Advantage on your next melee attack.

11.name: Cloak of Shadows
11.description: Action turns you Invisible in dim light or darkness until you attack or cast a spell.

17.name: Opportunist
17.description: Reaction allows a melee attack against a creature within 5 ft hit by an ally's attack.

3.name: Disciple of the Elements
3.description: Learn Elemental Attunement plus 1 Elemental Discipline fueling elemental attacks/spells with Ki (extra Disciplines at L6/11/17).

6.name: Elemental Disciplines (6th Level)
6.description: Learn an additional Elemental Discipline (unlocking higher Ki-cast elemental spells up to your tier limit).

11.name: Elemental Disciplines (11th Level)
11.description: Learn an additional Elemental Discipline including Wind/Fly/Stone/Fire mid-tier powers.

17.name: Elemental Disciplines (17th Level)
17.description: Learn a 4th Elemental Discipline (up to 6 Ki abilities such as Breath of Winter or River of Hungry Flame).

3.name: Touch of Death
3.description: When reducing a creature within 5 ft to 0 HP, gain Temporary HP equal to WIS modifier + Monk level.

6.name: Hour of Reaping
6.description: Action frightens all creatures within 30 ft that can see you (WIS save).

11.name: Mastery of Death
11.description: Spend 1 Ki point to drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP when reduced to 0 HP.

17.name: Touch of the Long Death
17.description: Spend 1–10 Ki as an Action to deal 2d10 Necrotic damage per Ki spent on a touch (CON save for half).

3.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
3.description: Hurl 30-ft ranged Radiant spell attacks using DEX + Martial Arts die; spend 1 Ki after Attack to hurl two bolts as Bonus Action.

6.name: Searing Arc Strike
6.description: Spend 2+ Ki immediately after taking the Attack action to cast Burning Hands as a Bonus Action.

11.name: Searing Sunburst
11.description: Action hurls a 20-ft radius orb of light within 150 ft dealing 2d6 Radiant (spend up to 3 Ki for +2d6 each; CON save negates).

17.name: Sun Shield
17.description: Shed 30-ft bright light and deal 5 + WIS mod Radiant damage as a Reaction when hit by a melee attack.

3.name: Drunken Technique & Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: Gain Performance & brewer's supplies proficiency; using Flurry of Blows grants free Disengage and +10 ft walking speed.

6.name: Tipsy Sway
6.description: Stand from Prone using only 5 ft of movement, and spend 1 Ki as a Reaction to redirect a missed melee attack onto another foe.

11.name: Drunkard's Luck
11.description: Spend 2 Ki to cancel Disadvantage on an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

17.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
17.description: Make up to 3 additional Flurry of Blows unarmed strikes when targeting distinct creatures.

3.name: Path of the Kensei
3.description: Designate melee & ranged Kensei weapons as Monk weapons, gain +2 AC with Agile Parry after an unarmed strike, and +1d4 damage on Kensei's Shot.

6.name: One with the Blade
6.description: Kensei weapon attacks count as magical, and spend 1 Ki once per turn to add Martial Arts die damage (Deft Strike).

11.name: Sharpen the Blade
11.description: Bonus Action spends 1–3 Ki to turn a nonmagical Kensei weapon into a +1/+2/+3 weapon for 1 minute.

17.name: Unerring Accuracy
17.description: Once per turn when you miss with a Monk weapon attack, reroll the attack roll.

3.name: Implements of Mercy, Hand of Healing & Hand of Harm
3.description: Gain Insight, Medicine, herbalism kit; replace an unarmed strike or Flurry with Hand of Healing (MA die + WIS) or spend 1 Ki on hit for +MA die + WIS Necrotic.

6.name: Physician's Touch
6.description: Hand of Healing cures conditions/diseases; Hand of Harm inflicts the Poisoned condition without a saving throw.

11.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
11.description: Use Hand of Healing freely with Flurry of Blows and apply Hand of Harm once per Flurry at no extra Ki cost.

17.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
17.description: Spend 5 Ki to restore a creature that died within 24 hours to life with 4d10 + WIS modifier HP (1/Long Rest).

hand_of_harm.name: Hand of Harm
hand_of_harm.hint: When you hit with an unarmed strike, spend 1 ki point to deal extra necrotic damage.

3.name: Arms of the Astral Self
3.description: Bonus Action spends 1 Ki to summon spectral arms (10 ft reach, Force damage using WIS instead of STR/DEX).

6.name: Visage of the Astral Self
6.description: Spend 1 Ki for 120 ft darkvision (seeing through darkness), 600 ft telepathic voice, and Adv on Insight/Intimidation.

11.name: Body of the Astral Self
11.description: Deflect Energy reduces Acid/Cold/Fire/Force/Lightning/Thunder damage and empowers one Astral hit per turn by +Martial Arts die.

17.name: Awakened Astral Self
17.description: Spend 5 Ki to summon full astral armor granting +2 AC and three attacks with the Attack action.

3.name: Draconic Disciple & Breath of the Dragon
3.description: Convert unarmed strikes to Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Poison and replace an Attack action strike with a 2x Martial Arts die cone/line Breath Weapon (PB/Long Rest or 2 Ki).

6.name: Wings Unfurled
6.description: Using Step of the Wind grants a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn (PB/Long Rest or free with Ki).

11.name: Aspect of the Wyrm
11.description: Bonus Action creates a 10-ft draconic aura granting allies elemental Damage Resistance or frightening foes (3 Ki after 1/Long Rest).

17.name: Ascendant Aspect
17.description: Gain 10 ft Blindsight, Breath scales to 3/4 MA dice + 20-ft explosive aura blasts on Aspect activation.
